quotes.text: An alarming and emerging threat made more apparent this year comes from the cyber domain. Cyberattacks launched from increasingly aggressive adversaries like China, North Korea, Iran and Russia will be countered by critical investments in cybersecurity and artificial intelligence.

And it unlocks technological capabilities to drive next-generation advancement. This includes the White House’s focus on propelling the U.S. to lead in artificial intelligence and new frontiers that keep us not only competitive – but unrivaled.
